title.zh: 外科杂病与皮肤科：井穴放血看血色定量，疮、肿块、静脉曲张仍先察经，皮肤病多取太阴尺泽、阴陵泉
title.en: Surgical Miscellany and Skin: Bleeding a Jing-well Guided by Blood Colour, Sores, Lumps and Varicose Veins Still Start from Palpation, Skin Disease Mostly Takes Taiyin Chize and Yinlingquan

summary.zh: 外科章的诊后絮语专讲井穴放血：位置在甲角下约0.1分，血量1~8滴引阳通络、8~15滴祛滞、16~20滴泻热，第1滴血色深则放至色浅、色浅为虚则至多约6滴。案例上，疮疖、蜂窝组织炎、肿块、静脉曲张都是先察经再选经；痔与大便失禁用督脉长强。皮肤科三案(银屑病、湿疹)与前章的过敏皮肤病同取尺泽、阴陵泉，但他强调并非一切皮肤病都取太阴。
summary.en: The surgical chapter's essay is about bleeding jing-well points: the site is about 0.1 fen below the nail corner; 1-8 drops leads yang out and frees the collaterals, 8-15 drops removes stagnation, 16-20 drops drains heat; if the first drop is dark keep bleeding until the blood pales, if it is pale (deficiency) about 6 drops at most. In the cases, sores, cellulitis, lumps and varicose veins are all palpated first, and haemorrhoids and faecal incontinence use Du-channel Changqiang. The three skin cases (psoriasis, eczema) take Chize and Yinlingquan as in the allergic skin cases, but he stresses that not every skin disease takes Taiyin.

takeaways.zh: 井穴放血的用意：井穴位于阴阳交会处，他说有引阳通络、泻实祛滞、宣痹开结的作用；取穴位置从指甲角侧线往下至甲根部，大约在指甲角下0.1分，如关冲在指甲外侧角下0.1分。案69的肿块就先在关冲放血几滴以激发手少阳经的气血运行。
takeaways.en: Why bleed a jing-well: the jing-well lies where yin and yang meet, and he says it leads yang out to free the collaterals, drains excess and stagnation, and opens obstruction and blockage. The site runs from the side line of the nail corner down to the nail root, about 0.1 fen below the nail corner; Guanchong, for example, is 0.1 fen below the outer nail corner. In Case 69 (a lump) he first bled a few drops at Guanchong to rouse Hand Shaoyang qi and blood.

takeaways.zh: 放血量对应作用：少量(1~8滴)引阳通络，止虚性痛；中量(8~15滴)祛滞，止实性痛；较多(16~20滴)泻热。血色显示虚实：色深为实证应多放，色淡浅为气虚勿放太多。他注明这些血滴数是临床常用数量、仅供参考。
takeaways.en: The amount matches the action: a little (1-8 drops) leads yang out and frees the collaterals, stopping deficient pain; a medium amount (8-15 drops) removes stagnation, stopping excess pain; more (16-20 drops) drains heat. Blood colour shows deficiency or excess: dark means excess and more may be let; pale means qi deficiency and not too much. He notes these drop counts are those commonly used in practice, for reference only.

takeaways.zh: 看第1滴血决定放几滴：第1滴色深为实证，继续放到血色变浅才止，有祛邪清热作用；第1滴色浅为虚证，最多6滴左右，只引阳通络。他的理由是血为气的载体，实证大量出血时阳气顺便带走邪气瘀滞，虚证大量放血则阳气随血而去、虚更重。灸井穴与少量放血相似，但灸有温阳通络作用，少量放血只引阳通络；病候也能预知血量，手指胀属实、麻属虚，十宣放血的疏通作用比井穴更广更强。
takeaways.en: Let the first drop decide how many. If the first drop is dark it is excess: keep bleeding until the blood turns pale, which expels pathogen and clears heat; if it is pale it is deficiency: about 6 drops at most, only to lead yang out and free the collaterals. His reason: blood carries qi, so in excess a large bleed takes the stagnant pathogen out with the yang, while in deficiency it takes yang away and worsens it. Moxa on the jing-well is much like a small bleed, except that moxa also warms yang while a small bleed only leads yang out; symptoms can predict the amount (distension of the fingers = excess, numbness = deficiency), and bleeding Shixuan opens more widely and strongly than a jing-well.

takeaways.zh: 疮疖和感染仍是先察经：案67蜂窝组织炎察出公孙(络穴)异常，判为热毒入足太阴络脉，他说阴经善温补、阳经善清泻，故多取足阳明经泻太阴络脉之热，用曲池配足三里(手足阳明合穴)与本经合穴阴陵泉；准备针手三里时摸不到原来的异常感，就改为曲池。案68外阴疮疖用审视、切候、循推、按压、扪抚五法，发现蠡沟结节与病灶相对、期门压痛，确认属足厥阴，取曲泉、太冲、公孙，起针后疮痛即消。
takeaways.en: Sores and infection are still palpation first. Case 67 (cellulitis): Gongsun (luo point) was abnormal, read as heat-toxin entering the Foot Taiyin collaterals; since yin channels warm and tonify and yang channels clear and drain, he mostly used Foot Yangming to drain the Taiyin collateral heat, Quchi with Zusanli (he-sea points of the two Yangming) plus the channel's own he-sea Yinlingquan; when he could no longer find the earlier abnormal feeling at Shousanli, he changed it to Quchi. Case 68 (vulvar boils): the five methods of inspection, touch, following, pressing and stroking showed a nodule at Ligou matching the site and tenderness at Qimen, confirming Foot Jueyin; Ququan, Taichong and Gongsun, and the sore pain vanished on removal of the needles.

takeaways.zh: 肿块也当经络病：案69右颈后风池前30年的肿块，位于足少阳，他先察手少阳(同名经)确认有异常，关冲放血激发气血，再用外关透四渎；他说外关既能治表里经，也治本经络脉病(孙络、浮络)，络脉位浅，与皮下肿块直接相关。古书未记载关冲治肿块，但因属少阳经络病故选用。次日肿块消失，他自己也说机制有待研究。
takeaways.en: A lump is also a channel disease. Case 69 (a 30-year lump behind the right neck, in front of Fengchi): it lies on Foot Shaoyang, so he first palpated Hand Shaoyang (same-name channel) and found it abnormal, bled Guanchong to rouse qi and blood, then threaded Waiguan toward Sidu. Waiguan treats the exterior-interior channel and also the channel's own collateral disease (minute and floating collaterals), which lie superficially and relate directly to a subcutaneous lump. The classics do not list Guanchong for lumps, but he used it because this is a Shaoyang collateral disease. The lump was gone next day, and he says the mechanism awaits study.

takeaways.zh: 静脉曲张取原穴配合穴，选经依据察经而非经验：案70以太阴经为主(尺泽、阴陵泉、血海、复溜)，后见厥阴异常，用太白配阴陵泉、太冲配曲泉；案71厥阴异常，取太冲、曲泉加络穴蠡沟。他解释原穴温阳益气、合穴调气机、络穴通本经络脉，并说选经依据是察经变化、经络气化和症候结构的结合，而不是凭经验。他还坦言调理经络不一定改变静脉结构，但能促进组织液流动、减轻静脉内压力。
takeaways.en: Varicose veins take yuan plus he-sea points, and channel choice follows palpation, not habit. Case 70 was mainly Taiyin (Chize, Yinlingquan, Xuehai, Fuliu), then Jueyin became abnormal, so Taibai with Yinlingquan and Taichong with Ququan; Case 71 was Jueyin, Taichong and Ququan plus the luo point Ligou. He explains that yuan points warm yang and boost qi, he-sea points regulate the channel's qi and luo points open all its collaterals, and stresses that the basis for choosing the channel is palpation, channel qi transformation and the symptom structure together, not experience. He admits adjusting channels does not necessarily change the vein structure, but moves tissue fluid and lowers venous pressure.

takeaways.zh: 痔与大便失禁：案65痔疮出血、察左孔最压痛，他取手太阴的郄穴孔最(阴经郄穴善止血)配督脉长强、腰俞；长强的操作有具体步骤：在尾骨下缘直刺、针贴尾骨前缘，得气后让患者反复收缩放松肛门，外痔常见立效，行针时能看到痔核回缩，腰俞是长强邻近穴以加强之。案66大便失禁判为脾肾两虚以肾虚为主，取长强点刺、太溪、阴谷、太白。
takeaways.en: Haemorrhoids and faecal incontinence. Case 65 (bleeding haemorrhoids, tender left Kongzui): he took the Hand Taiyin xi-cleft point Kongzui (yin-channel xi-cleft points stop bleeding well) with Du-channel Changqiang and Yaoshu. Changqiang has a defined technique: insert straight below the lower edge of the coccyx, needle against its front edge, and after de qi have the patient contract and relax the anal sphincter repeatedly; external piles often respond at once and the pile can be seen retracting during needling; Yaoshu is the neighbouring Du point that reinforces Changqiang. Case 66 (faecal leakage) was judged Spleen-Kidney deficiency, mainly Kidney: Changqiang pricked, Taixi, Yingu, Taibai.

takeaways.zh: 皮肤病与太阴：案72银屑病、案73和案74湿疹都察出太阴经异常，主穴尺泽、阴陵泉(太阴合穴，调升降出入，行津液润肌肤)，配曲池、血海清热活血；案74解读记初诊有内科医师按脏腑辨证用龙胆泻肝汤，而他按经络气化太阴主开，取太阴经。皮肤科诊后絮语点出三种不同的西医病同取一对穴属异病同治，同时提醒不要以为一切皮肤病都取太阴经。另有手法：膈俞(血会)放血引阳通络；至阳拔罐放血清热毒；案73点刺大椎行手法到手心出汗；案72待痒、脱皮减轻后再局部针，从最重的皮疹开始。
takeaways.en: Skin disease and Taiyin. Psoriasis (Case 72) and eczema (Cases 73, 74) all showed Taiyin changes; the main pair is Chize and Yinlingquan (Taiyin he-sea points, regulating rising, falling, entering and leaving, moving fluids to moisten skin), with Quchi and Xuehai to clear heat and move blood. The Case 74 comment records that at first an internal-medicine physician gave Longdan Xiegan Tang by zang-fu pattern, whereas by channel qi transformation Taiyin governs opening, so he took Taiyin. The skin essay points out that three different Western diagnoses taking one pair is "different disease, same treatment", and warns not to think every skin disease takes Taiyin. Techniques: bleed Geshu (blood gathering point) to lead yang out; bleed and cup Zhiyang to clear heat toxin; in Case 73 prick Dazhui with technique until the palms sweat; in Case 72 needle the local rash only after itching and scaling ease, starting from the worst patch.

how_to_use.zh: 放血前先看第1滴血色，按表1定量；疮、肿块、静脉曲张等外科病同样先察经(表2)。皮肤病见太阴异常再用尺泽、阴陵泉，并按表3的顺序处理局部皮疹。
how_to_use.en: Before bleeding, look at the first drop and set the amount by Table 1; for sores, lumps and varicose veins palpate first as well (Table 2). In skin disease use Chize and Yinlingquan only where Taiyin is abnormal, and treat the local rash in the order of Table 3.

caveats.zh: 血滴数是他注明“仅供参考”的临床常用数。案71穴名蠡沟在原文多作“沟”；案65解读在原文有断行缺字(“对痔疮的疗”)，只引其完整句子；“隔俞”“部穴”分别是膈俞、郄穴的OCR写法。外科章诊后絮语只有井穴放血一篇，皮肤科只有一段“异病同治”的按语，其余据案解读，力度较弱。
caveats.en: The drop counts are, in his words, those commonly used in practice and for reference only. the point Ligou in Case 71 is mostly printed only as 沟; the Case 65 comment has a broken line with missing characters (对痔疮的疗...) so only its intact sentences are quoted; 隔俞 and 部穴 are OCR forms of Geshu and xi-cleft point. The surgical chapter has only one essay (jing-well bleeding) and the skin chapter one short note on same treatment for different diseases; the rest rests on case comments and is thinner.
